scope.applies_to: every finalized taxonomy subject and subsubject
scope.purpose: Prevent resource presence from being misrepresented as expert capability.

requirements.description: Authoritative primary references or recognized institutional sources are mapped with provenance.
Advanced books, monographs, open course material, standards, or equivalent deep-study material is available with item-level rights verification.
Research literature, datasets, or current technical evidence is available where the discipline requires it.
Applicable standards, regulations, safety constraints, uncertainty, and limitations are represented where relevant.
The knowledge can be applied through worked problems, design exercises, simulations, analyses, experiments, or discipline-appropriate projects.
Outputs can be checked against requirements, evidence, test cases, reference solutions, peer-reviewed results, or discipline-appropriate verification and validation methods.
ATLAS runtime retrieval has been tested and returns the intended source material.
Answers can preserve source identity, provenance, version or date where applicable, and citation traceability.
A subject-specific expert assessment demonstrates synthesis, error detection, tradeoff reasoning, uncertainty handling, and application rather than memorization alone.

engineering_validation_model.principle: Verification checks compliance with requirements; validation checks fitness for intended use and stakeholder expectations.
